definitions.explanation: A shop where customers pay by the hour for a seat or booth with free access to a large manga library, drinks, and usually internet terminals. Many stay open all night and are used as cheap overnight lodging.

examples.japanese: {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent three hours at a manga cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I missed the last train and stayed at a manga cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦シャワー→シャワー：04503_shawaa⟧や⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many manga cafes these days even have showers and washing machines.

notes:
⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ + ⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧ (tea-drinking, as in ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧). Often shortened to {漫喫|まんきつ} in casual speech. Charged by the hour, with ⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (block rates) for longer stays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a manga cafe
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay overnight at a manga cafe
- {漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧: a private booth at a manga cafe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ネットカフェ→ネットカフェ：30266_nettokafe⟧: internet cafe — largely the same business; the name emphasizes the terminals rather than the manga
- ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧: coffee shop — an ordinary cafe, priced per drink rather than per hour
